info.title: Review Engine API
info.description: Authenticated REST API for the self-hosted Review Engine. Health checks and this document are public.

200.description: The application and database are ready.

post.summary: Exchange an administrator or active API token for an opaque browser session.
post.description: The credential is accepted only in this bounded JSON body and is never returned. The session is persisted as a hash and issued as an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie for /api/v1. Configure REVIEW_PUBLIC_ORIGIN to the canonical browser-facing origin; HTTPS origins make the cookie Secure.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly equal REVIEW_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, or the direct request origin when that setting is omitted for local development.

Set-Cookie.description: Opaque review_engine_session cookie; HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/api/v1, Max-Age=43200, and Secure for HTTPS deployments.

delete.summary: Revoke and expire the current browser session.
delete.description: Idempotent. If the session cookie is present, Origin must exactly match the configured or direct request origin.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Required when the review_engine_session cookie is present.

204.description: The session is absent or revoked and its browser cookie is expired.

Set-Cookie.description: Expires review_engine_session with the same security attributes.

200.description: The template version and its criteria.
A page of reviews in descending review-time order.

201.description: The created review. It is final when finalize=true and otherwise remains a draft.

200.description: Related entities discovered by bounded traversal.
The review and scores under its historical template.
The updated review. It is atomically finalized when finalize=true.

patch.description: Hide or restore a final or superseded review without modifying its historical content or status.

200.description: The review with its updated visibility metadata and revision.

post.description: Attach one to three pictures to a draft review. A review can contain at most three pictures; each picture can contain at most 100,000,000 bytes. JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF signatures are accepted. The review revision is incremented once for the batch.

409.description: PICTURE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED when the review would contain more than three pictures, or another immutable-state/optimistic-revision conflict.

get.description: Return picture bytes for a review that references the immutable picture asset.

200.description: The stored picture bytes with the detected media type.

delete.description: Remove a picture link from a draft review and delete an unreferenced asset.

200.description: The requested projection for each entity.

post.description: Export portable structured review data. Picture metadata and binary files are excluded; back up the complete data volume to preserve pictures.

200.description: Import validation results. Invalid documents still return 200 with valid=false.
All issued access-token records. Secrets are never returned.

201.description: The issued token. The secret is shown only once.

bearerAuth.description: Use REVIEW_ADMIN_TOKEN or an active revocable API token.

browserSession.name: review_engine_session
browserSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly browser session. Unsafe methods additionally require an Origin header that exactly matches REVIEW_PUBLIC_ORIGIN (or the direct request origin in local development).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

IncludeHidden.name: includeHidden
IncludeHidden.description: Include hidden review histories. Hidden reviews are excluded by default.

EntityIds.name: entityId
EntityIds.description: Repeat entityId to compare multiple entities. If omitted, up to 100 active entities are selected.

BadRequest.description: The JSON body or request syntax is invalid.

Unauthorized.description: The supplied credential, bearer token, or browser session is not active.

PayloadTooLarge.description: PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: the request body or one picture exceeds its configured byte limit.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: UNSUPPORTED_PICTURE_TYPE: a supplied file does not have a supported JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF signature.

Forbidden.description: A cookie-authenticated unsafe request did not have the required exact Origin.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with resource state or a concurrent update.

ValidationError.description: The request is syntactically valid but violates an input or domain rule.

url.description: Path relative to the API server base URL.

formatVersion.description: Exports use 1.1. Imports also accept 1.0, treating reviews without hidden_at as visible.
